image_description: A low-angle, close-up view of a massive white radio telescope dish structure. The image highlights the complex steel truss lattice supporting the parabolic reflector from underneath. To the left, a white staircase and walkway attach to the mounting structure. In the center background, an orange maintenance vehicle (possibly a crane or lift) is parked on gravel near railway tracks. The sky is blue with scattered clouds.
